name: Tikimp
look: a little black kickboxing monkey with spiky hair, a white skull face with a golden grin, bone stripes and huge white mitt hands and feet tipped in gold
entry: It paints its face like a skull to scare off bigger Pokémon, then kickboxes anything that isn't scared. It practises its kicks on bamboo all day long and never seems to tire.
how: Wild: uncommon in jungles, bamboo jungles, beaches and tropical islands.
